Saudi Arabia dismissed its anti-Houthi coalition commander as rebel forces advance toward Aden, now within 60 km, while Saudi-led coalition units have been forced to retreat from key areas. The coalition intercepted suspected Houthi missiles and drones, but Houthi forces repelled those attacks and killed a senior Yemeni military commander in Al-Jawf. Japan's ONE shipping group transited the Red Sea choke point for the first time in three years, showing limited commercial traffic.
